import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_68/test_0.csv"
]

# List to hold transformed DataFrames
transformed_dfs = []

# Process each source file
for file_path in source_files:
    # Load source data
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    
    # Extract the V_GENE from V_CALL by taking the substring before the first '-'
    # Example: "IGHV1-8*01" -> "IGHV1"
    df['V_GENE'] = df['V_CALL'].str.split('-', n=1).str[0]
    
    # Select only the target column
    transformed_df = df[['V_GENE']]
    
    # Append to list
    transformed_dfs.append(transformed_df)

# Concatenate all transformed dataframes (if multiple sources)
target_df = pd.concat(transformed_dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Save the result to the target path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_68/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)
